renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium Stella zodiac-guardian mutual-growth card master artwork, full-bleed vertical 3:4 with no border. Preserve character-sheet identity, relative size, colors, silhouette, canonical clothing and signature props. Every visible eye has a simple deep-purple pupil with exactly one large and one small highlight. Both guardians keep separate, clearly visible chest Stella stars. Keep the two guardians and focal mutual-growth cluster at 55–65% of the frame and readable at actual width 80px. Separate personal lanes, pots, roots, houses, stages, plants, stars, boxes, maps, stairs, tables, corals and currents must stay physically distinct. Every shared star, board, tab, marker, hinge, bridge, latch, clip, dock or divider stays removable, half-set, unlatched, open-ended, stoppable or reorderable.
